selection_reason: Previously selected by user; not optimized on posterior performance
quantity: Fixed 100-share lots at nightly acceptance, using current tracker quantity expression; never increased on gap-down
cash: Reserve accepted pending orders; reject insufficient-cash fills rather than resize an order based on future fill price
buy_trigger: Signal raw close; no fill on signal day; monitor through signal day plus 7 calendar days
buy_remainder: Cancel all unfilled shares after first trigger attempt, including zero fill; do not automatically retry next day
sell_remainder: Cancel unfilled sell shares, retain unsold holding; assume nightly rearming after review
protection_price: Tracker formulas rounded to 0.01; frozen signal ATR and actual simulated average fill price
double_touch: Stop first: conservative daily-bar convention, not a broker guarantee
signal_cutoff: Continuous to valuation cutoff; retain unfinished holdings at closing market value
capacity: User assumption: at most 2% of full-day volume, applies to buys and sells; not observed order-book liquidity
daily_fill_proxy: Inherited 0.2% adverse slippage, clipped to observed daily range; no actual five-level reconstruction
fees: Inherited research assumption: commission 0.0003 minimum5, sell stamp0.001; not claimed actual historical or current broker charges
exit_count_unit: Sell execution legs; partial exits count separately, not necessarily fully liquidated positions
unsupported_modes: Five-best-to-limit, same-side-best, opposite-side-best require separate queue/book assumptions; not simulated as interchangeable IOC modes
